summary: Short flat south kerb on a quiet street; homes 13-16 m away.
reasons: Only 10 m of kerb, fits one van

best_section.where: South kerb of Marmion Parade, just west of the side-street junction

drivers.seclusion: Dwellings 13-16 m south of the kerb, with houses and a pool close behind; trees and a hedge on the north side.
drivers.access_and_room: Sealed street; a car is parked at the kerb, so a van should fit but space is tight at 10 m.
drivers.convention: Cars park here, but one sign gives 2P parking Mon-Fri 7am-7pm, resident permits excepted.

flags: Very short stretch, barely one van long
Homes close on the section's side
sun_shade: Trees shade the kerb from the north; open to the east and west.
cannot_judge: Exact room beside the parked car
